title: Salvation and Grace - Episode 6: Jesus Our High Priest Who Knows Our Battles

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Welcome to Salvation and Grace. <chuckle> I'm Sarah Mitchell, and tonight I have a friend with me. <short pause> Jason, thank you for staying up with us.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.style: warm, relaxed, unhurried, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Thanks, Sarah. It's good to be here. <short pause> Hello, everyone. I'm Jason Greene.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Tonight we're asking a simple question... does Jesus really understand what it feels like to be you? <short pause> Not just in theory, but in the ache of your body and the weight on your mind.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.style: warm, relaxed, unhurried, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: That's a question I've asked more than once... <chuckle> usually around three in the morning.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: The writer to the Hebrews gives us an answer that has comforted believers for two thousand years. <short pause> He begins by pointing us to Jesus as our great high priest.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession. <long pause>

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: In the ancient temple, the high priest was the one person who could enter the holiest place... and stand before God for the people.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: But our high priest is different. <short pause> He isn't in a temple made of stone and gold. <short pause> He's at the right hand of the Father, interceding for us even now.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: And then comes the verse that, honestly, carried me through one of the hardest years of my life.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin. <long pause>

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Would you tell us about that year?

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: A few years ago, my father got sick... and I was the one who drove him to every appointment. <short pause> I was working full days, sleeping maybe four hours a night, and trying to hold it all together. <short pause> On the outside, I looked fine. <short pause> On the inside, I was angry, and scared, and too tired to pray.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: And the worst part was the shame. <short pause> I thought, a real believer wouldn't feel like this.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: So you stayed away.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: I did. <short pause> I thought I had to get myself together before I could come to God.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: And that's exactly what this verse speaks to. <short pause> Jesus isn't distant, or detached. <short pause> He knows what it is to be tired... to be misunderstood... to be let down by his closest friends. <short pause> He knows physical pain, and the pressure of demands no one else could carry.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: That's what got through to me. <short pause> One night in the hospital parking lot, I read that line... touched with the feeling of our infirmities. <short pause> And I realized Jesus wasn't looking at me with impatience. <short pause> He had been there.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: He wasn't asking me to be strong. <short pause> He was offering to help me.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: And yet, without sin.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: He felt every human weakness, every trial, and he never once turned away from the Father's will. <short pause> That's why he can help us, and not just feel sorry for us.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: Which leads to the next verse... my favorite.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need. <long pause>

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Boldly.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Not timidly. <short pause> Not with shame. <short pause> Not wondering if you have any right to be there.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: The throne of grace isn't a courtroom where you stand accused. <short pause> It's a place where mercy is ready... and help is waiting.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: For a long time, I treated prayer like something I had to earn. <short pause> Now I just come. <short pause> Tired, stumbling, sometimes without any words at all. <short pause> And I find mercy there. Every time.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Grace to help in time of need. <short pause> Your time of need isn't an interruption to God. It's exactly the moment he has provided grace for.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: My father passed away that spring. <short pause> The grief didn't disappear. <short pause> But I wasn't carrying it alone anymore.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Thank you for sharing that, Jason.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: So, for anyone listening tonight... think of the battle that's worn you down.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: The temptation that keeps circling back. <short pause> The relationship that drains you. <short pause> The fear that wakes you in the night.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: Jesus isn't confused by any of it. <short pause> He knows the ache behind the anger, and the loneliness behind the busyness.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: And because he knows, you can come. <short pause> You don't have to clean yourself up first, or wait until you have it all together.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You come as you are... <exhales> and you find mercy.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: The throne of grace is open tonight. <short pause> Jesus, your high priest, knows exactly what you're facing. <short pause> And he invites you to come boldly, not because of your own goodness, but because of his.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.style: warm, relaxed, unhurried, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Jason, thank you for being with me tonight.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.style: warm, relaxed, unhurried, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Thank you, Sarah. It was a gift to be here.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Let's pray. <short pause> Lord Jesus, thank you for knowing what it is to be human, for feeling what we feel, for walking through every trial without turning from your Father's will. <short pause> Help us to come boldly to your throne, trusting in your mercy and resting in your grace.

parts.speaker: Jason
parts.text: Rest well, everyone.

parts.speaker: Sarah
parts.text: Goodnight.
